svg.text: History optional — two millennia in, two centuries out
paper 1: ancient + medieval · paper 2: modern India + world · historiography is the differentiator
PAPER 1 — ANCIENT + MEDIEVAL
Sources: epigraphy · numismatics · texts as classes
Harappan: town planning · decline debates (palimpsest)
Vedic→janapada → Magadha → Maurya (Kautilya vs dhamma)
Post-Mauryan contacts · Gupta "classical" debates
Early medieval: feudalism debate (Sharma vs Mukhia) · Cholas
Sultanate: iqta, market reforms · Vijayanagara systems
Mughals: mansab-jagir · sulh-i-kul · Maratha polity · 18th-c debate
map pack ×12 (sites, edicts, ports, temple schools) = free marks
PAPER 2 — MODERN + WORLD
British rule: conquest line · settlements · drain theory (Naoroji)
1857 · deindustrialisation & famine policy debates
National movement: Swadeshi → Gandhi phases (NCM-CDM-QIM)
Readings: Cambridge vs nationalist vs subaltern
Partition · Constitution-making · Nehruvian consensus (to 1964)
World: revolutions · industrialisation · imperialism theories
Wars · inter-war crisis · decolonisation cases · Cold War end
structure: theme-inside-chronology + debate-card verdicts
TWELVE-WEEK FIRST PASS + REVISION RHYTHM
wk 1-3 ancient · wk 4-5 early-medieval + feudalism · wk 6-7 Sultanate-Mughals · wk 8-9 British+national movement · wk 10 world · wk 11 maps+1947-64 · wk 12 PYQ+dossier
monthly debate-cards: feudalism · 18th-c · deindustrialisation · Partition — claims ×3 schools + verdict
